releases.name: KD head models 2026-10-31 (final)
releases.body:
KD completed head models — 2026-10-31 (final)

Account: laniusnan; private repository: laniusnan/KD.
Snapshot: 34 completed runs, 18 model files.
Rotating ETF: one seed2101 per eligible pair; unfinished runs are not represented as final results.
VGG13→MobileNetV1 seed2101: linear67.79%, cosine66.39%, free ETF66.60%, rotating ETF66.63%.
Rotating ETF minus linear: -1.16pp; no positive KD gain in this first single-seed pair.
This observation is not a mechanism proof or a general statement about heterogeneous KD.
Model archives and result/provenance snapshots are SHA256-verified before publication.
After publication, a separate audited cleanup removes only these exact model bytes locally.
All native results, logs, predictions, recipes and linear/teacher dependencies remain local.
Download all assets; python3 restore.py --downloads DOWNLOAD_DIR --output EMPTY_RESTORE_DIR.
Independent archives must not be concatenated. Do not restore into an active training workspace.

releases.name: KD model backup 2026-10-27
releases.body:
Private, content-addressed backup of explicitly completed KD model artifacts.

Selected files: 2491; unique objects: 2215; archives: 158.
Selected logical size: 66.34 GiB; unique payload: 65.76 GiB.
This release remains a draft until every archive passes remote SHA256 verification.
Download MODEL_MANIFEST.json, SHA256SUMS, restore.py and required .tar.gz archives.
Restore: python3 restore.py --downloads DOWNLOAD_DIR --output EMPTY_RESTORE_DIR
Each archive is independent; do not concatenate archives. Duplicate original paths are restored from one object.
See EXCLUDED_FILES.json for omitted active/stopped/unclassified artifacts. No local original file is deleted.
Do not replace an active training workspace with a restoration. Source commit does not include all local study implementations.
